speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: In particular, Town Councils are responsible for the management of the local common areas and they are empowered to take action against recalcitrant offenders.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Ms Joan Pereira asked how prepared we are to deal with fires in high-rise residential buildings and how SCDF can work with grassroots organisations in raising public awareness of fire safety.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Indeed, taller buildings present greater challenges for firefighting operations.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: And this is why the Fire Code requires super high-rise residential buildings – buildings with more than 40 storeys – to have refuge floors or temporary holding spaces.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: These refuge floors serve as safe shelters for evacuees.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: In addition, such buildings are required to have at least two fire lifts, compared to only one fire lift in most high-rise buildings.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Fire lifts can be manually operated by the firefighters and can be used to facilitate the evacuation of the less-abled and the elderly.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: This addresses questions raised by Ms Anthea Ong and Dr Chia Shi-Lu.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: To address Ms Joan Pereira's point about working with grassroots organisations, SCDF thus works closely with the grassroots leaders on the Community Emergency and Engagement (C2E) Committees and the Community Emergency Response Teams (CERTs), so that they are familiar with the fire safety facilities and are able to facilitate evacuation.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Several Members have also spoken on the recent spate of fires involving PMDs and the need to enhance the fire safety requirements for such devices.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: I strongly encourage PMD users to switch to UL-2272-certified products as soon as possible, even before the deadline, as the required standard has in place some measures to better safeguard fire safety, such as a system for power supply to be cut off once the battery is fully charged.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: We will continue to work with LTA to educate the public on good fire safety habits.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Other than reviewing and strengthening our laws to ensure the robustness of our fire safety regime, I agree with Ms Anthea Ong that we must harness the power of the community.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: It is important to focus our efforts in public education and community involvement, to instil good fire safety habits and to help us become a fire-safe community.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Ms Joan Pereira, Mr Gan Thiam Poh, Mr Christopher de Souza, Assoc Prof Walter Theseira and Ms Anthea Ong have also touched on the need for public education in their speeches.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: SCDF engages residents during its regular community roadshows and post-fire door-to-door engagement sessions to share fire prevention tips and what to do in the event of a fire.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: SCDF also leverages these community engagement platforms to encourage members of the public to step up as community responders to deal with small fires in the neighbourhood.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: SCDF has also developed a suite of educational materials on various aspects of fire safety, such as "how to use a fire extinguisher", "fire safety at home", typical fire hazards at residential premises and dealing with "rubbish chute fires".

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: These materials are readily available on SCDF's website as well.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: At the local community level, SCDF also works closely with grassroots organisations on community outreach events.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Private residential premises are also engaged through the Safety and Security Days.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: We thank Ms Anthea Ong for her suggestion to work with other groups in our society – the FDWs and community volunteers.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Indeed, FDWs are part of our community and can be valuable assets in ensuring fire safety at homes.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: We are continually working to improve and enhance our outreach efforts and will take this suggestion into consideration.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: We cannot be complacent and take our low fire fatality rate for granted.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: So, apart from enhancing our laws, we will continue with our outreach and engagement efforts to engage and educate the public on fire safety.

speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira
text: Many Members asked the Ministry to consider mandating or subsidising various residential fire safety interventions, ranging from fire alarms to extinguishers and so forth.

speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira
text: I understand the Ministry has, of course, already considered many of these suggestions and, at the moment, I think most of our suggestions will not be adopted.

speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira
text: But I would like to ask whether the Ministry could consider conducting a risk-assessment, cost-benefit exercise and to publish the results of this exercise, considering some of the suggestions that we have made.

speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira
text: One is that this process will enhance fire awareness, it will also allow hon Members and the public to debate these issues more carefully the next time.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Indeed, we will welcome cost-benefit analyses, in particular, from learned Members, from academia, to understand the situation better.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: We will encourage eligible households to get on board.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Let us look at our implementation for the public rental flats, let us see what we can learn from there and then we will see how we can expand the scheme, if necessary.      .
